eps.o: Comedian and movie podcaster Paul Scheer and Katie Lee Biegel want to call "cut" on Bobby Flay and get chefs Rashida Holmes and Dave White their close-up.
Nadia Caterina Munno, aka "The Pasta Queen," holds court with Christian Petroni and their loyal subjects, chefs Kelsey Murphy and Michael Reed, to dub Bobby Flay a loser.
Bobby Flay meets his match when meteorologist Ginger Zee and Sunny Anderson storm the kitchen with chefs Basil Yu and Sanjay Rawat.
Powerhouse chefs Antonia Lofaso and Ayesha Nurdjaja recruit competitors Pete Amadhanirundr and Evelyn Garcia for a fierce showdown against Bobby Flay.
Love is in the air as actress Kaley Cuoco and Scott Conant team up with pastry chefs and spouses, Melissa and Sean McGaughey, for a bittersweet battle against Bobby Flay.
Bobby Flay's nearest and dearest, Brooke Williamson and Damaris Phillips, call on chefs Allyson Harvie and Christina Miros to challenge him with a dish he'll never forget.
TV personality Ross Matthews and podcaster Jaymee Sire rally crew members Matt Skrincosky and Allison Cancro to take down their boss, Bobby Flay.
Comedian Amber Ruffin and Tiffani Faison team up with chefs Tucker Ricchio and Evan Algorri to take Bobby Flay down with pride.
Actor Jeff Hiller and Amanda Freitag band together with chefs Thomas Bille and Keegan Andrews to cook up a spicy dose of defeat for Bobby Flay.
Journalist Hoda Kotb and Katie Lee Biegel recruit chefs Emma Woods and Quentin Garcia to take some joy in Bobby Flay's pain.
Bobby Flay gets blindsided by his Triple Threat Titans Ayesha Nurdjaja and Brooke Williamson with a surprise that changes everything.
